name: The Encircling Serpent
notes: Only its head ever enters the fight, and the rest of it is the horizon.
desc: A serpent so long that it lies around the whole world with its tail in its mouth. When it lifts its head the sea leaves the shore.
unbeatable: No hunter can reach more than a small part of it, and its venom fills the whole field.

name: Devourer of the Sun Boat
notes: It is cut apart every night in the old stories and is whole again by dusk.
desc: A serpent of darkness longer than a river of stars that waits below the horizon for the sun. Its eyes hold whatever looks into them.
unbeatable: It should come back whole from any defeat, so it can be driven off and never killed.

name: Hundun the Faceless
notes: It has no front and no back, and attacks against it find nothing to aim at.
desc: A vast, soft sack of a thing with six legs, four wings and no face at all. It is what there was before the world had shape.
unbeatable: It should have no weak point and no senses to deceive, so tricks and aimed blows mean little.

name: Father of Monsters
notes: Every monster in the gate is his child and comes when he calls.
desc: A giant whose head brushes the stars, with a hundred serpent heads growing from his shoulders and vipers for legs. Even the gods ran from him once.
unbeatable: He should bring a whole gate's worth of monsters with him and call more without end.

name: Zaratan, the Island That Wakes
notes: The fight takes place on its back, and it can dive.
desc: A sea turtle so large that forests and ruins stand on its shell. Sailors land on it and light fires, and then it remembers the deep.
unbeatable: The hunters stand on it, so it should be able to end the fight by going under.

name: Falak, the Fire Beneath
notes: It lies beneath the lowest hell, and only the fear of something greater keeps it from swallowing the world.
desc: A serpent of fire coiled under the deepest place there is. The ground glows from below wherever it turns in its sleep.
unbeatable: It should never be seen whole, and its heat alone should end a long fight.

name: The Deathless Tsar
notes: His death is hidden far away inside a needle, inside an egg, inside a duck, inside a hare, inside an iron chest.
desc: A gaunt, crowned old man in black mail, thin as a rake, who rides a horse that outruns the wind. He cannot die because his death is not in his body.
unbeatable: He should be unkillable in the fight itself, with his death an object hidden somewhere outside it.

name: The Fourth Rider
notes: He comes for everyone in the end and has never been late.
desc: A thin rider on a horse the colour of a corpse, with the grave following behind him. He does not hurry.
unbeatable: A hunter he names should die unless something outside the rules prevents it.

name: The First Hunter

abilities.name: The Stroke That Opened the Gates

notes: He has fought every monster in every gate and knows each skill the hunters hold.
desc: A quiet figure in gear so old that no guild remembers the make, with a badge worn smooth. He went into the first gate and has been inside ever since.
unbeatable: He should answer every skill used against him with its counter, as if he had the party's own sheets.

name: Emperor of the Last Pit
notes: He does not rise from his throne unless the hunters make him.
desc: A vast and once beautiful figure frozen to the waist at the bottom of everything, with ruined wings. Every other demon rules by his leave.
unbeatable: He should turn hunters against each other faster than they can hurt him, and command every demon there is.

name: Angel of the Last Trumpet
notes: It has held the trumpet to its lips since the beginning and waits for the word.
desc: A figure whose feet stand on the earth and whose head is above the sky, with a great horn raised. When it blows, everything is over.
unbeatable: The fight should be a countdown to one note that ends it, with no way to survive the note.

name: The World Engine

abilities.name: Piston the Size of a Tower

notes: The hunters fight inside it, and it rebuilds what they break.
desc: A machine as large as a country, all wheels and furnaces, built to turn the world and still turning. No one remembers who wound it.
unbeatable: It should repair itself faster than hunters can damage it unless its heart is found.

name: Mother of All Swarms
notes: Each of her dead is replaced by two more, and she lays as fast as they fall.
desc: A queen larger than a mountain, half buried, whose young have eaten whole lands bare. Every swarm that ever was began with her.
unbeatable: Her numbers should have no end, so the party is always outnumbered however many they kill.

name: Blight of the World Tree
notes: It is the sickness of the tree that holds the worlds up, and killing it may bring the tree down.
desc: A rot the size of a forest spreading through the trunk of the greatest tree there is. Black branches grow from it and reach for anything living.
unbeatable: Its roots should run under everything, so it heals from the ground and cannot be cut off from it.

name: Firstborn of the Frost
notes: The land the hunters stand on was made from one like him.
desc: A giant of ice older than the earth, asleep in the gap where nothing was. Frost giants are the sweat of his sleep.
unbeatable: His size should put him beyond harm, since any wound a hunter can make is too small to matter.

name: The Flood That Was Promised
notes: It has no body to wound, and it rises every round.
desc: Water without a shore, rising steadily, with shapes moving in it that might be a will. It was sent once to wash the world clean.
unbeatable: It should have nothing a weapon can strike, and the battlefield should shrink each round until none is left.

name: The Sea Before Shape
notes: Everything she kills is remade as one of her children.
desc: A dark, salt ocean that thinks, older than gods, from which the first monsters crawled. She wants back what was taken from her.
unbeatable: She should make new monsters out of the fallen without limit, the hunters' own dead included.

name: The Three Who Spin
notes: They do not fight at all, and they decide how the fight ends.
desc: Three old women at a wheel, a rod and a pair of shears, working without looking up. Every life is a thread in their hands.
unbeatable: They should know the result of each roll before it is made and be able to change it.

name: Night Without End
notes: Even the king of the gods was afraid to anger her.
desc: A woman's shape drawn in darkness with stars in her veil, wide enough to cover the sky. She is the mother of sleep, death and dreams.
unbeatable: No light should work near her, so the hunters fight blind for the whole of it.

name: The Gate That Hungers
notes: The hunters are already inside it when the fight begins.
desc: A gate with no dungeon behind it, only a throat. It opens where hunters gather and it has never been cleared.
unbeatable: It is the arena itself, so there should be no leaving and no boss room to end it by.

name: The Dragon at the Roots
notes: It will fly on the last day carrying the dead in its wings.
desc: A black dragon that lies under the deepest root of the world and chews on it, among the bodies of oath breakers. It has been patient for a very long time.
unbeatable: It should grow stronger with every death in the fight, on either side.

name: Cipactli, the Hungry Earth
notes: The earth was made from its body, and it still wants to be fed.
desc: A crocodile the size of a continent with a hungry mouth at every joint. It floats in the first sea and bites off the foot of anything that wades in.
unbeatable: It should take a sacrifice each round, and refusing to give one should cost the party more.

name: The Unburied Host
notes: It is every soldier who was ever left on a field, and it counts as one enemy.
desc: An army of the dead that stretches to the horizon, marching in silence under rotted banners. Each hunter who falls stands up in its ranks.
unbeatable: It should have no leader to kill, and every fallen hunter should strengthen it.
